text: Hello, I am Fredrick Sykes, former Mayor of West Covina, Member of the L.A. County Commission on Human Relations, Member of the Mt. S.A.C. Civilian Oversight Committee and Retired L.A. County Deputy Sheriff.
I first came to office during the Great Recession. I inherited a crisis: million-dollar deficits, reduced staffing, and proposals to sell public land.

Today, those problems have returned. West Covina is again running deficits while spending on an unnecessary City health department, subsidizing a frequently closed Sportsplex, and losing employees to a toxic environment. Corruption and fraud have again placed City assets at risk of sale.

The years I served on the Council were a time of recovery and stability, when many of you chose to build a life here and raise your children. Together, we saved Shadow Oak Park, restored staffing, and brought discipline back to the budget. We didn't impose burdens like weekly street-sweeping parking restrictions. Instead, we created an environment where businesses like Porto's saw West Covina as a jewel.
I ask for your support to get back to basics, bring stability to City Hall and put the City back to working for the residents as it did when I was a member of the West Covina City Council.

text: Over the past four years, we have worked hard to make West Covina a vibrant, safe, and proud city. As your current Councilman, I am proud of what we have accomplished together:

- Strengthened City Finances: Increased the City's financial reserves from $9 million to more than $24 million while maintaining a balanced budget through responsible fiscal management.
- Supported Local Businesses: Attracted new businesses and investment to create jobs, strengthen our local economy, and expand services for residents.
- Enhanced Public Safety: Hired 20 additional police officers and expanded emergency response capabilities by acquiring one quint truck, two fire engines, and five ambulances.
- Improved Infrastructure: Invested in parks, streets, traffic improvements, ADA accessibility, and neighborhood beautification to enhance residents' quality of life.

Over the next four years, I will continue working to build a:
- Safe City – Strengthen public safety to keep our neighborhoods clean, secure, and welcoming.
- Vibrant City – Deliver responsive, customer-focused city services while supporting economic growth and community development.
- Proud City – Position West Covina as a premier destination for business, entertainment, education, and the arts.
Together, we can continue building a safe, strong, and vibrant West Covina.
